questions.question: Explain the difference between a shell structure and a frame structure, with one example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A shell structure is hollow inside, with a thin, strong outer layer that holds its shape, like an egg, a snail shell or a plastic kennel. A frame structure is made of parts joined together like a skeleton, with spaces between them, like a bird cage, a kraal fence or a hen run.

questions.question: How can you make a wobbly square frame stronger?
questions.expected_answer: Add a part from one corner to the opposite corner. This makes two triangles, and triangles do not change shape easily, so the frame becomes stiff and strong.

questions.question: Name three things to think about when choosing materials for an animal shelter.
questions.expected_answer: Examples: whether it is strong enough, whether it keeps out rain or is waterproof, whether it lets in air and light, whether it keeps the animal cool or warm, whether it is safe for the animal and easy to clean.
